title: No-Churn Strawberry Cream Ice
blurb: A simple frozen dessert made by folding whipped cream through strawberry jam and fresh fruit. No ice cream maker needed.
steps: Hull and chop the strawberries into small pieces, then set aside.
Pour the cream into a large bowl and whip with an electric whisk until it holds soft peaks.
Sift in the icing sugar and add the vanilla extract, then whip briefly until the cream holds firm peaks.
Add the strawberry jam and chopped strawberries to the cream, then fold everything together gently with a spatula until just combined with visible streaks of jam.
Scrape the mixture into a freezer-proof container, smooth the top, and cover with a lid or cling film.
Freeze for at least 6 hours or overnight until firm enough to scoop.
